scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.dev:all: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'router'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix 9router-cloud install
